passives.name: Paldea Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with the Paldea theme you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.

teraMove.name: Dioptase Tera Blast
teraMove.description: Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. Lowers the target’s Defense by 1 stat rank. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

teraPassives.name: Add Some Color!
teraPassives.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain the first time the user’s Grass-type attack move is successful each battle. Lowers the target’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time the user’s Grass-type attack move is successful each battle. Turns the field of play’s zone into a Rock Zone the first time the user’s Rock-type attack move is successful each battle. (A Rock Zone powers up Rock-type attacks.) Lowers the target’s Rock Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time the user’s Rock-type attack move is successful each battle.
